title: Internet Computer – Why THESE signals could threaten ICP’s 14% price rally
summary: ICP continues to rally, but faces extreme bearish pressure behind the scenes.
content: Internet Computer (ICP) has experienced a notable 14 percent price rally, capturing the attention of the broader digital asset market. However, despite this upward price momentum, analysts point out that the cryptocurrency is currently facing significant underlying bearish pressure. These opposing market signals raise questions about whether the recent gains can be sustained in the near future.

title: Cronos says $9.2 million remains unrecovered after Tectonic exploit, chain rollback
summary: A subsequent rollback reversed roughly $111.2 million, but $9.19 million had already left the chain and remains unrecovered, Cronos says.
content: Cronos has announced that approximately $9.2 million remains unrecovered following a recent exploit and subsequent chain rollback on the Tectonic platform. While a network rollback successfully reversed an estimated $111.2 million, about $9.19 million had already been transferred off the chain before the intervention took place. Investigations and efforts regarding the remaining unrecovered funds are ongoing.
